limitations: reviewer and producer run on the same platform and the same model family: independence is identity-level and method-level, not model-level
without --live the review degrades to the pinned snapshot (A4 becomes not_run); with --live the live markdown hash was compared byte-exactly

I listed the reviewed package directory and opened its README.md/selfcheck.json while scoping it. selfcheck.json is treated as an object under test (C10 audits it by recomputation; its ok:true is never copied), and README prose is cited nowhere as evidence. This is a disclosure, not a claim of perfect context isolation.
no strong-model second sample was drawn (that is a platform-side job, not available here)

findings.title: 'eta_R = 1.0 is conservative' points the optimistic way for power adequacy
findings.detail: With eta_D = eta0*eta_H*eta_R and P_D = P_E/eta_D, eta_R=1.0 (instead of the report's own Holtrop-typical 0.98) raises eta_D by ~2% and therefore lowers the predicted delivered power. At eta_R=0.98 the minimum reported eta_D falls to 0.5057 against the report's own 0.50 band floor (margin 0.016 at eta_R=1.0). The band still holds, but the word 'conservative' is not licensed by the direction of the change. Not a defect of the registration (01 does not judge correctness).

evidence.quote: η_R 默认 1.0（偏保守：Holtrop 回归值约 0.98）

findings.recommendation: extraction must keep the numeric qualifier and may not keep the word 'conservative'.

findings.title: subject-report arithmetic is self-consistent for 5/5 ships; residual differences trace to integer rpm
findings.detail: T_req = R_T/(1-t) reproduces the reported thrust on all five ships (worst relative difference 0.000183), and eta_D = eta0*eta_H, J = V(1-w)/(nD), D/T = 0.70 and the I2/I3/I4 bands all reproduce to the printed decimals. Reported rpm is an integer, so J (prop. to 1/n) and P_D (prop. to n^3) are only determined to +-0.5 rpm: the recomputed P_D differs from the printed P_D by up to 0.016 relative, inside that interval. The gas-tight residual 1.11e-05 itself remains not_run.
findings.recommendation: quote rpm together with the +-0.5 rpm granularity whenever J or P_D is quoted.

findings.title: two non-resolved assets carry a status but no reason
findings.detail: 2 assets (1561-a025, 1561-a028) say only 'referenced_only_not_resolvable_from_this_record' with no prose reason, no present_in_worktree flag and no binary probe — the other 38 non-resolved assets carry at least one of those. Status-only is explicit, not a silent drop, hence non-blocking.
findings.recommendation: add a one-line reason (why it is not resolvable) for a025/a028.
